title: Driving past Epstein's 'Victoria's Secret Ranch' in New Mexico

tellings.quote: Really strange. I used to drive by that ranch all the time. I lived really close to it when I lived in New Mexico.

plain: He used to drive past the New Mexico ranch, Zorro Ranch, later tied to the financier Jeffrey Epstein and known locally as the Victoria's Secret ranch, all the time, says Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft for the government. Lazar says he lived very close to it in the years he lived in New Mexico and calls it "really strange".
